CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayIsEmpty

Returns TRUE if the array contains no elements.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayIsEmpty(array)

Parameters

array
The array to test. Passing something that is not an array is an error; test it first with IsArray.

Returns

TRUE (YES) if the array is empty, otherwise FALSE (NO).

Usage

ArrayIsEmpty(a) is the same test as ArrayLen(a) EQ 0, just easier to read.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Inbox = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Inbox empty? <B>#ArrayIsEmpty(Inbox)#</B></P>
<CFSET Temp = ArrayAppend(Inbox, "You've got mail!")>
<P>After one message arrives: <B>#ArrayIsEmpty(Inbox)#</B></P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayLen, ArrayClear, IsArray, StructIsEmpty
